Hi Sophie / Tom —

Great to jump on the call today — quick recap and a couple of follow-ups so we can align on pricing and procurement next steps.

Recap of what I heard on the call:
- Primary workload: realtime transaction summarization + customer support augmentation.
- Estimated traffic: ~20–30M tokens/month initially, with a pilot month that could be ~5–10M tokens.
- Average tokens per request (prompt + response): ~1.2k tokens.
- Peak day concurrency: ~150–300 reqs/min (you mentioned bursts during batch reconciliation).
- Procurement: anything > $50k requires procurement & security review; PO-based payment is preferred.

Two asks from us so we can put together a tailored pricing proposal:
1) Can you confirm the expected monthly spend band today (ballpark min / target / upside)?
2) Confirm procurement thresholds (PO limits, who in procurement to loop in, expected timeline).

We typically provide: pay-as-you-go, monthly committed tiers (discounts at volume), and Dedicated Capacity options for $50k+/mo profiles. Marissa (cc'd) will propose unit economics and committed tiers once we have the confirmed volume band.

I attached a short pricing reference we typically share for reference — I'll follow up with formal numbers.

Next steps:
- Sophie: confirm the monthly band and procurement contact (procurement@novapay.com ok?)
- Tom: any additional clarification on peak concurrency or SLA needs?
- Marissa: will send pricing ranges and committed options after Sophie confirms volume band.

Thanks — talk soon.

Thanks — putting numbers below so you can forward to Sophie. I kept bands broad and included both pay-as-you-go and committed options. These are draft ranges — final pricing needs legal and region confirmation.

Assumptions:
- Model family: rwd-large (production-optimized open model)
- Average tokens/request: ~1.2k
- Pilot: 30 days

Pay-as-you-go (no commit):
- Baseline unit: $220 per 1M tokens
- Billing: monthly, no minimum

Committed monthly tiers (12-month term discounts):
- 0–300M tokens total/year (month-to-month small commit): 10% off baseline → $198 / 1M tokens
- 300–1,200M tokens total/year: 25% off baseline → $165 / 1M tokens
- 1.2B+ tokens/year: contact sales (custom pricing / Dedicated Capacity)

Monthly spend bands (approx):
- <$10k/month: pay-as-you-go (no discount), recommended for pilots
- $10k–$50k/month: standard committed tier (10%–15% discount)
- $50k+/month: evaluate Dedicated Capacity (reserved GPU pools, SLA) — requires procurement + legal review and longer lead time

Procurement thresholds & notes:
- PO > $50k: legal & procurement review required (3–6 weeks typical).
- For pilots <$25k, we can accept standard MSA addendum and push a faster approval path.
- We can provide SOC2 and KMS attestations as part of the procurement packet.

Pilot credit:
- We can offer a $5k pilot credit for 30 days. Credit applied to first invoice; pilot needs a short SOW (1 page) describing success criteria. I'll attach a pilot SOW template and an MSA draft for procurement.

Next steps I recommend we propose to Novapay:
1) 30-day pilot: 5–10M tokens, $5k credit, quick SOW.
2) If pilot meets success criteria, convert to 12-month commit at the 300M/year tier (approx $165 / 1M tokens).
3) If scaled quickly to >$50k/month, open Dedicated Capacity discussion and SLA.

I've attached the MSA draft and the pricing reference. Dylan, send this note to Sophie and include the MSA / pilot SOW.
